subject: general
question: Narendra finishes a job in 10 days. Amit completes the same job in 12 days. How many days will it take for both of them to finish the job while working together?
solution:
Given:

Narendra can finish a job in = 10 days

Amit can complete the same work in = 12 days

Concept used:

Efficiency = (1)/(Time taken)

Calculation:

According to the question;

Narendra's 1-day work or Efficiency of Narendra = (1)/(10)

Amit's 1-day work or Amit's efficiency = (1)/(12)

(Narendra + Amit)'s 1-day work or Combined efficiency = (1)/(10) + (1)/(12)

= ((6 + 5))/(60) = (11)/(60) 

So, The time taken to complete the work together is = (1)/(Combined efficiency)

(1)/((frac{11){60})} = (60)/(11)

= 5(5)/(11)days

∴ They together will finish the work in** 5(5)/(11)**days.
